source: Passive observation of operator touchscreen run; recorder sent GET requests and subscribed to events only

channel_result.message: The provided Z position would exceed the travel limits

conclusion: A channel-calibration failure was observed while the touchscreen owned the procedure. This does not identify the physical cause or establish that all earlier Lacry failures had the same cause.
coverage: Events, error dialogs, status/result changes, and overlapping MNE/MLP/RCE trace windows. Historical traces are also included; filter by their native timestamps. No continuous measured-axis telemetry is available in this recording.
recorder_note: Recorder later stopped on a Windows snapshot replacement lock after the instrument had returned Idle. The recording preserves the failure and abort. Snapshot publishing was subsequently changed to tolerate transient sharing locks.
